intro.title: Where the Ionian breeze begins
intro.p1: Cape Avra sits on the cape of Mytikas, five kilometres from Preveza, where the land ends and the Ionian opens up. A wide garden of palms, agaves and shade trees runs to the garden wall. Beyond it lie the beach and the open sea.
intro.p2: In the evening the sun sets into the water and the mountains of Lefkada turn blue on the horizon.
intro.p3: Avra (αύρα) is the Greek word for the soft breeze that comes in off the sea on summer afternoons. It gave the house its name.
intro.caption: Lefkada on the horizon, seen from the upper floor.

sea.title: Front row on the Ionian
sea.text: The house looks straight out to open water. Swim at the beach below, then watch the light change from the garden.

garden.title: A garden for long days
garden.text: A wide lawn with palms and agaves, shade under the pergola and room for everyone. Dinner outdoors, with the sea just beyond the wall.

privacy.title: Yours alone
privacy.text: One house, one group of guests. No shared spaces, no strangers at the next table. Just your own garden and your own gate to the sea.

location.title: On the cape of Mytikas
location.text: A quiet stretch of Ionian coast just north of Preveza. The long sandy beach of Monolithi runs north from here, and the ruins of ancient Nikopolis are a few minutes inland. Lefkada and Parga are easy day trips.
